items.title: Police pushed back protesters near Barakhamba Road during INDIA bloc SC march
items.summary: Delhi Police pushed back protesters near Barakhamba Road during the INDIA bloc's 'March for Democracy' to the Supreme Court against CEC Gyanesh Kumar (thedailyjagran day-3 live blog, 05:47 PM IST entry — landed after the prior run's full-page check; distinct from the earlier-logged ~4:48 PM IST stoppage at Bhagwan Das Road). No detentions or injuries reported in the entry.

items.title: Traffic police: Mandi House roads affected, 'maximum available force' deployed
items.summary: Amid the INDIA bloc march, Additional Commissioner of Police (Traffic) Dinesh Kumar Gupta said Mandi House and roads in the division are affected: 'substantial force has been deployed. We have deployed our maximum available force; traffic is being properly regulated, and we are issuing advisories accordingly' (thedailyjagran day-3 live blog, 06:06 PM IST entry).

items.title: Dhruv Rathee claims he is 'unofficially under house arrest' with police surveillance
items.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee (released ~3 AM IST Oct 11 after the Jantar Mantar crackdown) claims he is 'unofficially' under house arrest: ~50 police personnel stationed outside his residence, being followed wherever he goes, and threatened with immediate detention if he goes near a protest; he said he wanted to join Monday's INDIA bloc march to the SC but was prevented (reported by thedailyjagran via Lallantop; article published 12:58 PM IST Oct 12 — pre-baseline but never logged by earlier runs; self-reported, not independently corroborated).
